title: Population size reduction methods in differential evolution: a comprehensive review and experimental analysis
title_zh: 差分进化中的种群规模缩减方法：全面综述与实验分析
abstract: Abstract Optimization plays a crucial role in modern engineering and science. Evolutionary computing techniques are a branch of artificial intelligence (AI) and have attracted a lot of attention recently. Scientists, engineers, and practitioners need to understand how evolutionary computing techniques work and be fluent in using AI-based optimization techniques to solve engineering optimization problems. The Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm, which is classified as a population-based evolutionary algorithm, is primarily intended for solving complex optimization problems. The original DE algorithm uses a fixed population size, whereas modern DE variants adopt advanced strategies for reducing the population size over the evolution process. In this review article, 204 studies are included and we offer not only an overview of the population size reduction methods, but also a comparative analysis of selected methods by integrating them into the state-of-the-art algorithm and performing experimental work on the CEC 2024 benchmark functions and two real-world problems. Benchmarking demonstrates that the choice of population size adjustment strategy affects optimization performance, with its effectiveness depending on the problem characteristics and dimensionality. According to the Friedman test applied to 15 methods, 10 non-linear population size reduction methods were ranked higher than the linear population size reduction method on 100-dimensional problems. Moreover, a non-linear population size reduction method achieved the top rank on both real-world optimization problems. However, no single population size adjustment strategy consistently dominates across all problem dimensions and function families.
abstract_zh: 摘要：优化在现代工程与科学中扮演着关键角色。进化计算技术是人工智能（AI）的一个分支，近年来受到广泛关注。科学家、工程师和从业者需要了解进化计算技术的工作原理，并熟练运用基于 AI 的优化方法解决工程优化问题。差分进化（DE）算法是一种基于种群的进化算法，主要用于解决复杂优化问题。原始 DE 算法采用固定种群规模，而现代 DE 变体则采用先进策略在进化过程中逐步缩减种群规模。本文综述了 204 篇研究，既概述了种群规模缩减方法，也通过将选定方法集成到最先进的算法中，并在 CEC 2024 基准函数以及两个真实世界问题上进行实验，提供了对比分析。基准测试表明，种群规模调整策略的选择会影响优化性能，其有效性取决于问题特性和维度。对 15 种方法应用 Friedman 检验后，10 种非线性种群规模缩减方法在 100 维问题上排名高于线性方法。此外，非线性种群规模缩减方法在两个真实世界优化问题上均获得最高排名。然而，没有单一的种群规模调整策略在所有维度和函数族中始终占据主导地位。
